title: Pricing | Northwind Analytics
description: Simple plans for product teams of every size. Save 20% with annual billing.
markdown:
# Pricing

Simple plans for product teams of every size. Prices in USD. Save 20% with annual billing.

## Starter

**$29/month** billed annually ($35 billed monthly)

- 3 seats
- 1M tracked events per month
- 90-day data retention

## Team

**$79/month** billed annually ($99 billed monthly)

- 12 seats included, additional seats $8/seat/month
- 10M tracked events per month
- Funnels, retention and cohort reports
- 13-month data retention

## Business

**$249/month** billed annually ($299 billed monthly)

- 40 seats included
- 50M tracked events per month
- SSO (SAML) and audit logs

## Enterprise

Custom pricing. Unlimited seats, dedicated support and a 99.95% uptime SLA. [Contact sales](https://www.northwind-analytics.com/contact-sales)

---

Prices updated September 1, 2026. See the [changelog](https://www.northwind-analytics.com/changelog) for details.

title: Our 2025 pricing update | Northwind Analytics Blog
description: New plans for 2025: Starter, Team and Business.
markdown:
# Our 2025 pricing update

*February 3, 2025*

Starting today we're simplifying our plans. The new **Team** plan is **$69/month** billed annually and includes **10 seats**. Starter stays at $25/month with 3 seats, and Business is $199/month with 30 seats.

Existing customers keep their current price until renewal.
